intent: A list of the sections on one long page. It jumps to a section and shows the one the page is at.
useWhen: A long page split into named sections, like settings or a long record
A reading page where people need to see where they are and jump
doNotUseWhen: Switching views on one screen — use Tabs
Steps in a flow — use ProgressSteps

items.note: Each id is the id of that section on the page.

variant.note: rail is the list. menu is the same list in a popover for narrow screens.

offset.note: Pixels to keep clear of a sticky header when jumping.

menuLabel.note: Menu trigger label before a section is current.

requirements: Escape closes only this panel, not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
Rail is a nav landmark. Each row is a link to the section id
The current section has aria-current=location, a caret, and a strong line
Clicking a row scrolls to the section and moves focus to it
Arrow keys, Home, and End move between rows
Menu variant: the trigger is a button with aria-expanded. Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
Do not point a row at a section that is not on the page

doNot: Do not use AnchorNav for app navigation — use AppNav
Do not use it to switch views — use Tabs
Do not use it for steps in a flow — use ProgressSteps
Do not point a row at a section that is not on the page
snippet: <AnchorNav variant="rail" items={[{ id: "details", label: "Details" }, { id: "billing", label: "Billing" }]} />
